title: XSS Protection
definition: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) occurs when an attacker injects malicious JavaScript into your database, which is later served to other users. To prevent this, you must sanitize user input. In Express, you can use `xss-clean` to strip out HTML tags from incoming requests.
